title: Policy
text: Reinforcement learning policy, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Policy block data MAT file}, {Policy parameter inputs} adds policy parameters input ports and create bus object and parameter, {Policy parameter bus name} sets the name of policy parameters bus object and {Generate IC blocks} sets the generate blocks containing initial conditions for the policy parameters. Values come from the instance.
